name: SalSon Logistics - Newark NJ (481 Doremus Warehouse)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance off Doremus Avenue at the SE end of the property (~40.7162,-74.1289). Street View (2025) shows a sliding chainlink gate across a wide truck driveway, full chainlink perimeter fencing along Doremus, and a small gatehouse-scale structure beside the entry. Z20 satellite confirms the gated driveway apron and a small booth structure beside the entry lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small 1-vehicle-footprint structure sits beside the truck-gate driveway (visible in z20 satellite and Street View) — consistent with a staffed gatehouse for an AIB-rated food-grade warehouse / container-storage yard. remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock line runs along the SW face of the warehouse with numerous trailers backed in; estimate ~38 doors, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer/container drop area along the south and east sides of the property; 10-25 band estimate, flagged uncertain because the large open lot to the SW appears to be shared/adjacent rather than fenced inside the SalSon parcel.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits directly on Doremus Avenue, a two-lane city arterial; truck queue at the gate would stack onto the public road. Limited stacking depth before the road.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal driveway/apron from the gate runs deep alongside the building toward the dock face — room for a 3+ truck queue inside the gate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single main warehouse plus a small attached office/secondary structure; not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters this parcel; the Newark rail corridor is nearby but does not serve this building directly.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified from overhead imagery; left uncertain.
